{'translated': 'iOS 27 beta 5 was released yesterday, which in addition to redesigned app icons and new Siri AI voice options, also brings updates that make Liquid Glass more transparent than ever.', 'translated_zh': 'iOS 27 beta 5 昨日發佈，除咗重新設計嘅 app 圖示同全新 Siri AI 語音選項之外，今次更新仲可以令 Liquid Glass 比以往更加透明。'}

{'translated': "iOS 27's Liquid Glass slider in beta 5 offers more advanced transparency settings", 'translated_zh': 'iOS 27 嘅 Liquid Glass 滑桿喺 beta 5 提供更加進階嘅透明度設定'}

{'translated': "When iOS 27 officially launches next month, it will bring optimizations to Apple's Liquid Glass design across several aspects of the iPhone interface.", 'translated_zh': '下月 iOS 27 正式推出時，將會喺 iPhone 介面嘅多個方面為 Apple 嘅 Liquid Glass 設計帶嚟優化。'}

{'translated': 'But iOS 27 also adds an important customization tool: the Liquid Glass slider.', 'translated_zh': '但 iOS 27 同時加入咗一項重要嘅自訂工具：Liquid Glass 滑桿。'}

{'translated': 'Inside "Settings" → "Appearance" → "Liquid Glass," the new slider lets you adjust the Liquid Glass transparency to your liking. You can make it extremely transparent, very dark, or somewhere in between.', 'translated_zh': '喺「設定」→「外觀」→「Liquid Glass」入面嘅新滑桿，可以讓你調校至最鍾意嘅 Liquid Glass 透明度。你可以調到極為透明、好深色，或者介乎兩者之間。'}

{'translated': "In this week's beta 5, Apple has adjusted the slider so that the most transparent setting is even more transparent than before.", 'translated_zh': '喺今個星期嘅 beta 5，Apple 已調整咗滑桿，令最透明嘅設定比起之前更加透明。'}

{'translated': 'You can see a great comparison on X from Beta Profiles:', 'translated_zh': '你可以喺 X 嘅 Beta Profiles 睇到一個好好嘅對比：'}

{'translated': 'This change isn\'t huge, but if you prefer making UI elements as transparent as possible, iOS 27 can deliver a more "glassy" experience.', 'translated_zh': '呢個改動唔算好大，但如果你鍾意將 UI 元素盡可能調到透明，咁 iOS 27就可以提供更加「玻璃感」嘅體驗。'}

{'translated': 'The beauty of the slider is that no matter your preference, iOS 27 can make it happen.', 'translated_zh': '滑桿嘅好處就係，無論你有咩偏好，iOS 27 都可以幫你實現。'}

{'translated': 'How do you like to set your Liquid Glass? Drop a comment and let us know.', 'translated_zh': '你鍾意將 Liquid Glass 點樣設定？歡迎留言討論。'}

  • {'translated': '10-year battery life AirTag case', 'translated_zh': '10 年續航 AirTag 保護殼'}
